items.description_en:
25% chance to shoot sticky tears
Sticky tears grow and explode after a few seconds, dealing Isaac's damage +60
items.description_zh:
25%概率发射粘性泪弹
粘住的泪弹会变大并在几秒后爆炸, 造成1x角色伤害+60的伤害
items.wiki_description: Isaac's tears have a chance to stick to enemies and explode.

items.name: Chaos
items.description_en:
All items are chosen from random item pools
Spawns 1-6 random pickups
items.description_zh:
底座道具会从随机道具池产生
生成1-6随机掉落物
items.wiki_description: Drops 1-6 random pickups on the floor. Causes items to be chosen from random item pools.

items.name: Spider Mod
items.description_en:
Displays tear damage and health bars of all enemies
Inflicts random status effects to enemies on contact
Randomly spawns batteries or blue spiders
items.description_zh:
显示泪弹伤害和所有敌人的血条
接触敌人时, 施加随机状态效果
清理房间后, 概率生成蓝蜘蛛/小电池
items.wiki_description: Displays Isaac's tear damage and enemy health bars. Spawns a familiar that wanders around and inflicts random status effects on enemies it touches. Can spawn a Lil' Battery (Category:Modified in RepentanceMicro Battery) / Blue spider upon clearing a room.

items.name: Farting Baby
items.description_en:
Blocks projectiles
When hit, 10% chance to fart and charm, poison or knockback enemies
The farts deal 5-6 damage
items.description_zh:
阻挡弹幕
受击时, 10%概率放屁, 效果为魅惑/中毒/击退三种其一
屁造成5-6点伤害
items.wiki_description: Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac and blocks enemy shots. If a shot hits Farting Baby, it has a chance to fart, which charms, poisons, or knocks back nearby enemies.

items.name: GB Bug
items.description_en:
Throwable (double-tap shoot)
Rerolls enemies and pickups it comes in contact with
items.description_zh:
可投掷(双击发射键)
重置其接触到的敌人和掉落物
items.wiki_description: Category:Modified in Repentance Spawns a familiar that bounces diagonally around the room, applying a random status effect to enemies it hits and has a chance to re-roll pickups it passes over. Category:Modified in Repentance Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac. Double tapping the fire button launches it forward, causing it to reroll the first monster or pickup it hits.

items.name: D8
items.description_en:
Multiplies Isaac's damage, tears, range and speed stats by between x0.5 and x2
The multipliers are rerolled each use
items.description_zh:
角色的伤害, 射速, 射程, 移速属性的修正x0.5-x2
修正在每次使用后重置
items.wiki_description: Re-rolls Isaac's damage, tears, range, and speed.

items.name: Purity
items.description_en:
Boosts one of Isaac's stats depending on the color of the aura
Taking damage removes the effect, and grants a new effect in the next room
Yellow = +0.5 Speed
Blue = +2 Fire rate
Red = +4 Damage
Orange = +3 Range
items.description_zh:
根据光环颜色对角色属性进行增强
受伤时, 移除光环, 在下个房间获得新的光环
黄色 = 移速+0.5
蓝色 = 射速修正+2
红色 = 伤害+4
橙色 = 射程+3
items.wiki_description: Boosts one of Isaac's stats depending on the color of the aura around him. The aura disappears upon taking damage and reappears with a random color upon entering a new room. Red boosts damage, blue boosts tears, yellow boosts speed, and orange boosts range.

items.name: Athame
items.description_en:
25% chance for a black brimstone ring to spawn around killed enemies
It deals 30x Isaac's damage over 2 seconds
 +2.5% chance per luck
items.description_zh:
25%概率在被击杀敌人周围生成黑色硫磺火圈
黑圈2秒内造成30x角色伤害
 每点幸运+2.5%概率
items.wiki_description: Category:Modified in Repentance When Isaac takes damage, a damaging black ring briefly appears around him. This ring can cause enemies to drop Black Hearts. Category:Modified in Repentance After Isaac kills an enemy, adds a luck-based chance to spawn a damaging black ring around them.

items.name: Empty Vessel
items.description_en:
+2 Black Hearts
 When Isaac has no Red Hearts:
Flight
Every 40 seconds while in a hostile room, gain a shield for 10 seconds
items.description_zh:
+2黑心
 角色没有红心时:
获得飞行
在有敌人的房间中, 每40秒产生1个持续10秒的护盾
items.wiki_description: Grants two Black Hearts. While Isaac has no red hearts, grants flight and periodically grants an invincibility shield for a few seconds.

items.name: Evil Eye
items.description_en:
3.33% chance to shoot an eye
 10% chance at 20 luck
The eye moves in a straight line and shoots tears in the same direction as Isaac
items.description_zh:
3.33%概率发射眼睛
 幸运20: 10%概率
眼睛缓慢移动并发射与角色方向一致的泪弹
items.wiki_description: Adds a chance to fire a slow-moving eye that fires tears in the same direction as Isaac. The eye is destroyed when it hits an enemy or obstacle.

items.name: Lusty Blood
items.description_en:
+0.5 Damage for each enemy killed in the room
Caps at +5 Damage after 10 kills
items.description_zh:
击杀敌人时, 在当前房间中伤害+0.5
最多击杀10个敌人伤害+5
items.wiki_description: Isaac's damage increases for the current room each time he kills an enemy.

items.name: Cambion Conception
items.description_en:
Taking damage 15 times spawns a permanent demon familiar
After two familiars, it takes 30 instead of 15
Caps at 4 familiars
items.description_zh:
受伤15次, 30次, 60次, 90次时, 永久获得1个恶魔跟班
最多产生4个跟班
items.wiki_description: After taking damage a certain amount of times, a permanent demonic familiar spawns.

items.name: Immaculate Conception
items.description_en:
Picking up 15 hearts spawns a permanent angelic familiar and a Soul Heart
Caps at 5 familiars
items.description_zh:
每拾起15次心, 永久获得1个天使跟班并生成1魂心
最多产生5个跟班
items.wiki_description: Upon picking up a certain amount of health, spawn a permanent angelic familiar.

items.name: More Options
items.description_en: Allows Isaac to choose between 2 items in treasure rooms
items.description_zh: 允许宝箱房道具二选一
items.wiki_description: Two item pedestals are presented in every Treasure Room. Only one can be taken; the other will disappear.

items.name: Crown Of Light
items.description_en:
+2 Soul Hearts
If Isaac has no damaged heart containers:
 x2 Damage multiplier
 -0.3 Shot speed
Taking any damage removes the effect for the room
items.description_zh:
+2魂心
若角色无不满的心之容器:
 伤害修正x2
 弹速-0.3
受伤后, 在当前房间中效果消失
items.wiki_description: +2 Soul Hearts. While Isaac has no empty red hearts, grants 2x damage, -0.3 shot speed, Category:Modified in Repentance and increased range. Regardless of health, the crown deactivates for the current room when Isaac takes damage.

items.name: Deep Pockets
items.description_en:
If clearing a room would yield no reward, spawns 1-3 coins
 Increases the coin cap to 999
items.description_zh:
若清理房间没有奖励, 则生成1-3硬币
 提高硬币上限至999
items.wiki_description: Category:Modified in Repentance Allows Isaac to carry two cards or pills (or a combination of both) at the same time. Category:Modified in Repentance Increases the coin cap to 999. If a room would otherwise yield no reward, 1-3 coins will spawn.

items.name: Succubus
items.description_en:
Bounces around the room surrounded by a damaging aura that deals 7.5-10 damage per second
 x1.5 Damage multiplier while standing in the aura
items.description_zh:
在房间中漂浮的跟班, 产生伤害光环, 每秒造成7.5-10点伤害
 站在光环中伤害修正x1.5
items.wiki_description: Spawns a flying familiar that bounces around the room with a black aura, dealing rapid damage to any enemies inside it. While standing in the aura, Isaac gains a 1.5× tear damage multiplier.

items.name: Fruit Cake
items.description_en: Each one of Isaac's tears gets a different effect
items.description_zh: 每颗泪弹都有不同效果
items.wiki_description: Isaac's tears gain a random effect that changes every shot.

items.name: Teleport 2.0
items.description_en:
Teleports Isaac to a room that has not been cleared yet
Hierarchy: >>>>>>>> >>>>>>>
items.description_zh:
传送至未探索的随机房间
等级: >>>>>>>> >>>>>>>
items.wiki_description: Teleports Isaac to a room that has not been explored yet. Normal rooms are prioritized over special rooms, and common special rooms take priority over rarer ones.

items.name: Black Powder
items.description_en:
Walking in a circle draws a pentagram on the floor, which deals 130 damage over 4 seconds
Grants bigger explosions
Fireplaces explode when extinguished
items.description_zh:
在地上走1个圈会产生五角星符号, 4秒内造成130点接触伤害
获得更大范围的爆炸效果
火堆熄灭时会爆炸
items.wiki_description: Isaac leaves a trail of black powder on the floor. Walking in a circle will spawn a pentagram symbol on the floor, which deals 10 damage per tick to any enemies inside it. Category:Modified in Repentance+ Grants larger explosions and fireplaces will explode when extinguished.

items.name: Kidney Bean
items.description_en: Charms all enemies in close range
items.description_zh: 魅惑近距离的所有敌人
items.wiki_description: Isaac farts, charming all nearby enemies.

items.name: Glowing Hourglass
items.description_en:
Brings Isaac back to the previous room and reverses all actions done in the room the item was used in
The rewind can be used three times per floor
 Acts as The Hourglass when out of rewinds, which slows enemies down for 8 seconds
items.description_zh:
将角色带回上个房间, 回退所有使用时房间的行动
每层仅可使用三次
 用尽次数后与沙漏作用一致, 即使敌人减速8秒
items.wiki_description: Rewinds time, putting Isaac back in the previous room and undoing anything that happened in the current room. Category:Modified in Repentance Can only be used three times per floor, after which it functions like The Hourglass until the next floor.

items.name: Circle of Protection
items.description_en:
Surrounds Isaac with a large halo that deals his damage on contact per second
Chance to reflect enemy projectiles
items.description_zh:
角色周围产生1个大光环, 每秒造成1x角色伤害
概率反弹敌人弹幕
items.wiki_description: Surrounds Isaac with a large white halo that occasionally deals Isaac's tear damage to enemies inside it, and can convert enemy shots into friendly homing tears.

items.name: Sack Head
items.description_en:
Pickups have a chance to be replaced with a sack:
: 10%, : 20%
 Spawns a sack
items.description_zh:
掉落物有概率由福袋取代:
: 10%, : 20%
 生成1福袋
items.wiki_description: Spawns a Grab Bag on pickup. Coins, Bombs, Keys, cards, runes and batteries have a chance to become Grab Bags.

items.name: Night Light
items.description_en:
Spawns a slowing cone of light in front of Isaac
Removes Curse of Darkness for the current floor
items.description_zh:
在角色面前生成锥形光, 使其中的敌人和弹幕减速
移除当前层黑暗诅咒
items.wiki_description: A cone of light shines in the direction Isaac is moving that slows enemies and enemy shots.

items.name: Obsessed Fan
items.description_en:
Mimics Isaac's movement on a 0.66 second delay
Deals 30 contact damage per second
items.description_zh:
模仿角色移动, 有0.66秒延迟
每秒造成30点接触伤害
items.wiki_description: Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac's movements on a delay and deals 30 contact damage per second to enemies.

items.name: Mine Crafter
items.description_en:
Spawns a pushable TNT barrel
Using the item a second time in the same room remotely detonates the barrel
items.description_zh:
生成1个可推的TNT桶
在相同房间中第二次使用时, 远程引爆之前生成的桶
items.wiki_description: Places a Movable TNT barrel that can be pushed and used to destroy rocks or damage enemies. If used again in the same room while the previous TNT barrel is still intact, remotely detonates the TNT.

items.name: PJs
items.description_en:
Full health
 +4 Soul Hearts
items.description_zh:
回满血
 +4魂心
items.wiki_description: Grants 4 Soul Hearts and fully restores Isaac's health.

items.name: Head of the Keeper
items.description_en: Hitting an enemy with a tear has a 5% chance to spawn a Penny
items.description_zh: 敌人被泪弹击中时, 5%概率掉落1硬币
items.wiki_description: Isaac's tears become coins. Hitting an enemy has a 5% chance to drop a Penny.

items.name: Papa Fly
items.description_en:
Mimics Isaac's movement on a 0.66 second delay
 Shoots tears at nearby enemies that deal Isaac's damage
items.description_zh:
模仿角色移动, 有0.66秒延迟
向附近敌人发射泪弹, 造成1x角色伤害
items.wiki_description: Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac's movements on a 3 second delay, firing tears at nearby enemies.

items.name: Multidimensional Baby
items.description_en:
Mimics Isaac's movement on a 0.66 second delay
Tears that pass through it are doubled and gain a range + shot speed boost
items.description_zh:
模仿角色移动, 有0.66秒延迟
经过它的泪弹会分成2个并有射程+弹速加成
items.wiki_description: Spawns a familiar that will follow Isaac's movements on a 2.5-second delay. Tears that pass through the baby will be doubled and increase in speed.

items.name: Glitter Bombs
items.description_en:
+5 Bombs
 Bombs have a 63% chance to drop a random pickup and a 15% chance to charm enemies when they explode
The pickup spawn chance goes down by 1% for each spawn this floor
items.description_zh:
+5炸弹
角色的炸弹爆炸时, 63%概率生成1随机掉落物, 15%概率魅惑炸到的敌人
当前楼层每次生成掉落物后, 生成概率降低1%
items.wiki_description: +5 Bombs. Bombs have a chance to drop random pickups or charm enemies when they explode.

items.name: My Shadow
items.description_en:
A small shadow follows Isaac
 When an enemy touches the shadow a friendly black charger spawns for the room
The charger deals 8.7 damage per hit
items.description_zh:
紧跟着角色的影子
 当敌人接触影子时, 在当前房间中生成1个友好的黑蛆
黑蛆每秒造成8.7点伤害
items.wiki_description: Category:Modified in Repentance Inflicts fear on all enemies in the room upon taking damage and spawns black friendly Chargers that attack enemies. Category:Modified in RepentanceSpawns a shadow familiar that closely follows behind Isaac. It spawns a black friendly Charger whenever an enemy touches it.

items.name: Jar of Flies
items.description_en:
Killing an enemy adds a blue fly to the jar, up to 20 flies
Using the item releases all the flies
items.description_zh:
击杀敌人时, 在罐子里加入1只蓝苍蝇, 最多20只
使用时, 释放所有苍蝇
items.wiki_description: Killing an enemy adds a fly to the jar, up to a maximum of 20. On use, releases Blue Flies equal to the number of flies in the jar.

items.name: Lil Loki
items.description_en:
Shoots 4 tears in a cross pattern
Deals 3.5 damage per tear
items.description_zh:
十字发射泪弹
泪弹造成3.5点伤害
items.wiki_description: Spawns a Loki familiar that follows Isaac and fires 4 tears in a cross pattern.

items.name: Milk!
items.quote: t cry over it...Dont cry over it...
items.description_en:
Blocks enemy projectiles
 After 10 hits, it breaks and grants a Tears up for the remainder of the floor
items.description_zh:
阻挡弹幕
 受击10次后, 破裂并在本层获得射速提升
items.wiki_description: Category:Modified in AfterbirthCategory:Modified in Repentance+ Spawns a glass familiar that follows Isaac. After Isaac takes damage, the milk spills, and he gains -2 tear delay (Category:Modified in Repentance +1.0 fire rate) until leaving the room Category:Modified in Repentance+ Spawns a glass familiar that follows Isaac. The milk will block projectiles, and upon blocking 10, the milk spills, giving Isaac +1.0 fire rate for the rest of the floor.

items.name: D7
items.description_en:
Restarts a room and respawns all enemies
Can be used to get multiple room clear rewards from a single room
items.description_zh:
重新开始房间并重生所有敌人
能够从同一房间获得多次清理房间奖励
items.wiki_description: Restarts the current room and respawns all monsters, allowing more rewards to be acquired by completing the room.

items.name: Binky
items.description_en:
+0.75 Tears
Size down
 +1 Soul Heart
items.description_zh:
射速+0.75
 +1魂心
体型变小
items.wiki_description: Grants one Soul Heart, +0.75 tears and decreases Isaac's size.

items.name: Mom's Box
items.description_en:
Spawns a random trinket
While held:
 +1 Luck
 Doubles trinket effects
items.description_zh:
生成1随机饰品
持有时:
 幸运+1
 饰品效果翻倍
items.wiki_description: Increases luck by 1 and doubles the effects of trinkets while held. When used, drops a random trinket on the ground.

items.name: Kidney Stone
items.description_en: Isaac occasionally stops firing and charges an attack that releases a burst of tears and a kidney stone
items.description_zh: 角色约每25秒停止发射并蓄力, 释放散射泪弹和1颗肾结石
items.wiki_description: Isaac is occasionally forced to stop firing and charge an attack that launches a massive piercing, spectral kidney stone and a barrage of tears. Category:Modified in Repentance -0.2 speed, decreases range.

items.name: Mega Blast
items.description_en:
Fires a huge Mega Satan blood beam for 15 seconds
The beam persists between rooms and floors
items.description_zh:
发射超级撒但血激光柱15秒
激光在房间和层之间持续存在
items.wiki_description: Isaac fires a giant blood laser for approximately 15 seconds. This laser deals massive damage, pushes Isaac backwards, and persists between rooms and floors.

items.name: Dark Prince's Crown
items.description_en:
While at 1 full Red Heart:
 +2 Fire rate
 +1.5 Range
 +0.2 Shot speed
items.description_zh:
红心为1时:
 射速修正+2
 射程+1.5
 弹速+0.2
items.wiki_description: Category:Modified in Repentance When at exactly one Red Heart, +0.75 tears, +1.5 range, and +0.2 shot speed. Category:Modified in Repentance When at exactly one Red Heart, +2 fire rate, +1.5 range, and +0.2 shot speed.

items.name: Apple!
items.description_en:
+0.3 Tears
 6.66% chance to shoot razor blades that deal 4x Isaac's damage
 100% chance at 14 luck
items.description_zh:
射速+0.3
 6.66%概率发射刀片, 造成4x角色伤害
 幸运14: 100%概率
items.wiki_description: +0.3 tears. Adds a chance to fire a razor blade that deals 4× Isaac's damage.

items.name: Lead Pencil
items.description_en: Isaac shoots a cluster of tears every 15 tears
items.description_zh: 角色每发射15颗泪弹, 抛射大量泪弹
items.wiki_description: After every 15 tears fired, Isaac will fire a high-damage cluster of tears.

items.name: Dog Tooth
items.description_en:
+0.1 Speed
 +0.3 Damage
 A wolf howls in rooms adjacent to a Secret/Super Secret Room
 A dog barks in rooms with a crawlspace under a rock
items.description_zh:
移速+0.1
 伤害+0.3
 在隐藏房/超级隐藏房相邻房间时会有一声狼嚎
 进入石头下有暗门的房间时会有一声吠叫
items.wiki_description: +0.3 damage, +0.1 speed. Plays a howl or bark sound when entering a room with undiscovered Secret Rooms or Crawl Spaces.

items.name: Dead Tooth
items.description_en: While firing, Isaac is surrounded by a green aura that poisons enemies
items.description_zh: 发射泪弹时, 角色周围会有使敌人中毒的绿环
items.wiki_description: While firing, Isaac gains a green aura that poisons nearby enemies.

items.name: Linger Bean
items.description_en:
Firing without pause for 4 seconds spawns a poop cloud
The cloud increases its size over 10 seconds
The cloud deals less damage the bigger it gets
It can be moved by shooting it
items.description_zh:
每连续发射4秒时, 生成一朵便便云
10秒内尺寸不断变大
尺寸越大伤害越低
可通过射击便便云使其移动
items.wiki_description: Constantly shooting causes Isaac to release gas clouds that can be pushed by his tears and damage nearby enemies. Category:Modified in Repentance+ The cloud will gradually increase in size, while the damage it does gradually decreases.

items.name: Shard of Glass
items.description_en:
Upon taking damage:
 25% chance to spawn a Red Heart
 Isaac bleeds, spewing tears in the direction he is shooting
The bleeding does half a Red Heart of damage every 20 seconds
The bleeding stops if a Red Heart is healed, all Red Hearts are empty, or the next damage would kill Isaac
items.description_zh:
受伤时:
 25%概率生成1红心
 角色流血, 向角色发射方向喷泪弹
流血每20秒造成半红心伤害
治疗红心, 红心用尽或下一次受伤致死时, 流血停止
items.wiki_description: Category:Modified in Repentance Upon taking damage, Isaac has a chance to drop a full red heart, gain 5 range, and leave a trail of damaging red creep for the current room. Category:Modified in Repentance Taking damage causes Isaac to bleed, spraying a volley of blood in the direction he fires. Bleeding will eventually damage him, but it can be stopped by picking up a Red Heart.

items.name: Metal Plate
items.description_en:
+1 Soul Heart
 Enemy bullets have a 25% chance to be reflected as concussive tears
items.description_zh:
+1魂心
 使敌人的弹幕有25%概率反弹为混乱泪弹
items.wiki_description: Grants one Soul Heart. Enemy shots have a chance to be reflected at the shooter as confusing tears.

items.name: Eye of Greed
items.description_en:
Every 20 tears, Isaac shoots a coin tear that deals x1.5 +10 damage
 Enemies hit with the coin get petrified and turn into gold
 Killing a gold enemy drops 1-3 coins
 Firing a coin tear costs 1 coin
items.description_zh:
每发射20颗泪弹, 发射1颗硬币泪弹, 造成1.5x角色伤害+10的伤害
 被硬币泪弹击中的敌人石化并变为金块
 击杀金敌人掉落1-3硬币
 发射硬币泪弹消耗1硬币
items.wiki_description: Every 20 tears, Isaac loses 1 Penny and shoots an additional gold tear that petrifies enemies and turns them into gold. Any enemy killed while in this state will drop coins.

items.name: Tarot Cloth
items.description_en:
Spawns a card
 Tarot card effects are doubled or enhanced
items.description_zh:
生成1卡牌
 部分塔罗牌效果翻倍或增强
items.wiki_description: Drops a random tarot card. Category:Modified in Repentance Doubles the effects of most cards and runes. Category:Modified in Repentance Doubles the effects of tarot cards.

items.name: Varicose Veins
items.description_en:
Taking damage shoots 10 tears in a circle around Isaac
The tears deal Isaac's damage + 25
 20% chance to activate the Anemic effect for 2 seconds
items.description_zh:
受伤时:
围着角色发射10颗泪弹
 泪弹造成1x角色伤害+25的伤害
 20%概率获得持续2秒的贫血效果
items.wiki_description: Taking damage releases a ring of 10 high damage tears.

items.name: Compound Fracture
items.description_en:
+1.5 Range
Tears shatter into 1-3 bone shards upon hitting anything
items.description_zh:
射程+1.5
泪弹击中时碎成1-3个小骨片
items.wiki_description: Increases Range. Tears turn into bones, which shatter into 1-3 bone shards upon hitting an enemy or obstacle.

items.name: Polydactyly
items.description_en:
Spawns a rune, card or pill on pickup
Allows Isaac to carry 2 runes/cards/pills
items.description_zh:
生成1符文/卡牌/胶囊
允许角色携带2卡牌/符文/胶囊

Deals 30 contact damage per second to other enemies
items.description_zh:
在随机敌人周围环绕直到该敌人死亡
每秒对其他敌人造成30点接触伤害
items.wiki_description: Spawns a fly familiar that orbits around a random enemy and deals 30 damage per second to enemies it comes in contact with.

items.name: Black Hole
items.description_en:
Throwable black hole, which sucks in everything
Deals 6 damage per second
Destroys nearby rocks
Lasts 6 seconds
items.description_zh:
可投掷的黑洞, 会吸入所有东西
每秒造成6点接触伤害
摧毁附近的石头
持续6秒
items.wiki_description: Throws a black hole on the ground which sucks in and damages enemies and destroys nearby obstacles.

items.name: Bozo
items.description_en:
+0.1 Damage
 +1 Soul Heart
 Randomly charms/fears enemies
Taking damage has a 5% chance to spawn a Rainbow Poop
items.description_zh:
伤害+0.1
 +1魂心
 概率魅惑/恐惧敌人
受伤时, 5%概率生成1个彩虹大便
items.wiki_description: +0.1 flat damage, grants a Soul Heart. Enemies can randomly become briefly charmed or feared. Taking damage has a chance to spawn a Rainbow Poop.

items.name: Broken Modem
items.description_en:
Causes some enemies and projectiles to briefly pause at random intervals
Paused projectiles disappear
25% chance to double room clear rewards
items.description_zh:
随机间隔使一些敌人和弹幕短暂停滞
暂停的弹幕消失
25%概率使清理房间奖励翻倍
items.wiki_description: Enemies, enemy shots, tears, and pickups will briefly freeze in place at random intervals. The reward from clearing a room will sometimes be duplicated.

items.name: Mystery Gift
items.description_en:
Spawns a random item from the current room's item pool
Chance to spawn Lump of Coal or The Poop instead
items.description_zh:
根据当前房间的道具池生成1个随机道具
概率生成煤块/大便
items.wiki_description: Spawns a random item from the current room's item pool, with a chance to spawn A Lump of Coal or The Poop instead.

items.name: Sprinkler
items.description_en: Spawns a Sprinkler that shoots the same tears as Isaac in a circle around itself
items.description_zh: 生成1个洒水器, 转圈发射泪弹
items.wiki_description: Creates a stationary sprinkler for the current room that rotates and fires tears in 8 directions. The tears copy Isaac's stats and most tear effects.

items.name: Fast Bombs
items.description_en:
+7 Bombs
Removes the delay between bomb placements
Bombs don't deal knockback to each other
items.description_zh:
+7炸弹
移除放置炸弹的冷却
炸弹相互之间不会击退
items.wiki_description: +7 Bombs. Removes the delay between bomb placements, allowing them to be placed rapidly. Category:Modified in Repentance Bombs will no longer knock each other away.

items.name: Buddy in a Box
items.description_en:
Familiar which looks like a random co-op baby
Has random tear effects
Effects change every floor
items.description_zh:
与合作宝宝外观一样的跟班
随机泪弹效果
效果每层都会变化
items.wiki_description: Spawns a familiar with a random tear effect. The familiar is randomized at the start of each floor.

items.name: Lil Delirium
items.description_en: Transforms into a random familiar every 10 seconds
items.description_zh: 每10秒变成随机跟班
items.wiki_description: Grants a familiar that transforms into another random familiar every 10 seconds.

items.name: Jumper Cables
items.description_en: Killing 15 enemies adds 1 charge to the active item
items.description_zh: 每击杀15个敌人主动道具充能1格
items.wiki_description: Grants an active item charge every 15 enemies killed.

items.name: Coupon
items.description_en:
Makes one random item in the Shop or Devil Room free
Holding the item guarantees one Shop item is on sale
items.description_zh:
使商店/恶魔房的随机1个物品免费
 持有时, 进入商店必有1个商店物品打折
items.wiki_description: While held, guarantees one item in every Shop will be on sale for half price. On use, makes a random item in the current room free.

items.name: Telekinesis
items.description_en:
Stops all enemy projectiles that come close to Isaac for 3 seconds and throws them away from him afterwards
Pushes close enemies away during the effect
items.description_zh:
使靠近角色的敌人弹幕停滞3秒, 结束后弹幕会被抛开
效果期间推开靠近的敌人
items.wiki_description: Any enemy shots that come near Isaac for the next three seconds are held in place then fired back.

items.name: Moving Box
items.description_en:
Stores up to 10 pickups and items from the current room
Using the item again drops everything back on the floor
Allows Isaac to move things between rooms
items.description_zh:
使用时, 储存当前房间中最多10掉落物
再次使用将储存物放回地上
允许角色在房间之间搬东西
items.wiki_description: If the box is empty, picks up items and pickups in a room and stores them. If the box is not empty, places all stored items and pickups in the current room. Category:Modified in Repentance Can carry up to 10 items or pickups at once.

items.name: Technology Zero
items.description_en:
Isaac's tears are connected with beams of electricity
Electricity deals 4.5x Isaac's damage per second
items.description_zh:
泪弹以电弧连接
 电弧每秒造成4.5x角色伤害
items.wiki_description: Connects Isaac's tears with electricity that can damage enemies.

items.name: Leprosy
items.description_en:
Taking damage spawns a projectile blocking orbital
Caps at 3 orbitals
They deal 30 contact damage per second
Orbitals are destroyed if they take too much damage
items.description_zh:
受伤时, 生成1个阻挡弹幕的环绕物
最多有3个环绕物
每秒造成30点接触伤害
环绕物受伤过多后被摧毁
items.wiki_description: Taking damage grants a body part orbital that blocks shots and deals contact damage, up to a maximum of three. The body parts are destroyed after blocking enough damage.

items.name: 7 Seals
items.description_en:
Spawns a small horseman familiar that spawns locusts
The horseman and its locust changes every 10 seconds
items.description_zh:
生成小天启骑士跟班, 能生成对应的蝗虫
骑士及其蝗虫每10秒更换一次
items.wiki_description: Spawns a random Harbinger familiar that changes every 10 seconds. Harbingers have different behaviors and spawn themed Locusts.

items.name: Mr. ME!
items.description_en:
Displays a movable cursor for a few seconds, then summons a ghost that will, depending on the cursor position:
Open doors or chests
Fetch an item
50% chance to steal from the Shop / Devil
Attack an enemy until it dies
Explode walls, rocks, shopkeepers, angel statues, machines, beggars
Presses the button
items.description_zh:
几秒内显示可移动光标, 随后生成幽灵, 根据光标位置:
打开门或箱子
带回物品
50%概率在商店/恶魔房偷东西
攻击敌人直到目标死亡
炸开墙/石头/天使雕像/店主/机器/乞丐
按下压力板
items.wiki_description: Summons a controllable ghost that can perform various tasks depending on what it targets.

items.name: Angelic Prism
items.description_en:
Orbital prism
Friendly tears hitting it split into 4
items.description_zh:
棱镜环绕物
友方泪弹击中它会分裂成4个
items.wiki_description: Spawns an orbital familiar with a large orbital radius. Tears that pass through the prism split into four multi-colored tears.

items.name: Pop!
items.description_en: Isaac's tears bounce off each other and disappear when they stop moving
items.description_zh: 角色的泪弹会彼此弹开, 停止移动时消失
items.wiki_description: Replaces Isaac's tears with eyeballs that can bounce off of each other. The eyeballs are not limited by range, and will instead dissipate when they stop moving or when hitting an enemy or obstacle.

items.name: Death's List
items.description_en: Killing enemies in the order dictated by the mark above them grants a random pickup or stat increase
items.description_zh: 按顺序击杀标记的敌人可获得奖励
items.wiki_description: Grants a pickup or stat upgrade if all enemies in a room are killed in the order they are marked.

items.name: Haemolacria
items.description_en:
+1 Damage
 x1.5 Damage multiplier
 x0.33 Fire rate multiplier
 x0.8 Range multiplier
Isaac's tears fly in an arc and burst into smaller tears on impact
items.description_zh:
伤害+1
 伤害修正x1.5
 射速修正x0.33
 射程修正x0.8
角色的泪弹呈抛物线前进, 击中时分裂成更小的泪弹
items.wiki_description: Turns Isaac's tears into large blood tears fired in an arc. Upon hitting the floor, an obstacle, or an enemy, they burst into many smaller tears in all directions. Increases tear delay.

items.name: Lachryphagy
items.description_en:
Isaac's tears progressively slow down, stop, then explode into 5-8 smaller tears
Tears can merge and become bigger
items.description_zh:
角色的泪弹前进时减速, 停止后会爆裂成5-8颗小泪弹
泪弹可以合并变大
items.wiki_description: Isaac's tears decelerate as they travel. Upon stopping or hitting an obstacle, they burst into 8 tears in all directions. Tears can be fired into other tears to feed them, increasing their damage.

items.name: Trisagion
items.description_en:
Replaces Isaac's tears with piercing beams of light
The beams deal 33% damage but can hit enemies multiple times
items.description_zh:
角色的泪弹由穿刺光束弹取代
每秒造成15次33%角色伤害
items.wiki_description: Tears are replaced with piercing white blasts of light that deal less damage but can damage the same enemy multiple times.

items.name: Schoolbag
items.description_en:
Allows Isaac to hold 2 active items
The items can be swapped using the Drop button ()
items.description_zh:
允许角色持有2个主动道具
按掉落键()切换
items.wiki_description: Allows Isaac to hold two active items.

items.name: Blanket
items.description_en:
Heals 1 heart
 +1 Soul Heart
 Entering a boss room grants a Holy Mantle shield (prevents damage once)
items.description_zh:
治疗1红心
 +1魂心
 进入头目房时产生神圣屏障护盾, 阻挡1次伤害
items.wiki_description: Grants one Soul Heart. Upon entering a boss room, grants a shield that blocks one hit, then disappears.

items.name: Sacrificial Altar
items.description_en:
Sacrifices up to 2 familiars and spawns a devil item for each sacrifice
 Turns blue spiders/flies into coins
items.description_zh:
献祭最多2个跟班并生成同样数量的恶魔房道具
 将蓝蜘蛛/蓝苍蝇变成硬币
items.wiki_description: Sacrifices up to two familiars and spawns an item pedestal for each familiar sacrificed. Converts all friendly spiders and flies into coins.

items.name: Lil Spewer
items.description_en:
Spawns a random pill on pickup
Fires a line of creep
The type of creep changes with each pill use
items.description_zh:
生成1随机胶囊
发射一条水迹
每次使用胶囊后, 水迹类型改变
items.wiki_description: Drops a random pill, and spawns a familiar that charges up and fires creep. Using pills changes the creep type.

items.name: Marbles
items.description_en:
Spawns 3 random trinkets
 Taking damage has a 10% chance to consume Isaac's held trinket and grant its effects permanently
items.description_zh:
生成3随机饰品
 受伤时, 10%概率消耗角色持有的饰品并永久获得其效果
items.wiki_description: Spawns 3 random trinkets. Taking damage has a 5% chance to swallow Isaac's currently held trinket, gaining its effect permanently.

items.name: Mystery Egg
items.description_en:
Taking damage spawns a friendly enemy
Spawns stronger friends the more rooms are cleared without taking damage
items.description_zh:
受伤时, 生成1个友好的敌人
未受伤清理的房间越多, 生成的帮手更强
items.wiki_description: Spawns an egg familiar, which hatches a random friendly monster when Isaac is hurt once per room. The power of the monster improves for each consecutive room cleared without taking damage.

items.name: Flat Stone
items.description_en: Isaac's tears bounce off the floor and cause splash damage on every bounce
items.description_zh:
角色的泪弹会在地面弹起
 每次弹起对附近敌人造成0.25x角色伤害
items.wiki_description: Tears bounce off the floor, creating splashes. Splashes deal 25% of Isaac's tear damage to all enemies in a small area.

items.name: Marrow
items.description_en:
Spawns 3 Red Hearts
 +1 Bone Heart
items.description_zh:
生成3红心
 +1骨心
items.wiki_description: Grants one Bone Heart and spawns three Red Hearts.

items.name: Slipped Rib
items.description_en:
Orbital
Reflects enemy projectiles
items.description_zh:
环绕物
反弹敌人弹幕
items.wiki_description: Spawns a bone familiar that circles around Isaac and reflects enemy shots.

items.name: Hallowed Ground
items.description_en:
Taking damage spawns a white poop
While inside the poop's aura:
 x2.5 Fire rate multiplier
 x1.2 Damage multiplier
Homing tears
50% chance to block damage
items.description_zh:
受伤时, 生成白大便
在大便光环中时:
 射速修正x2.5
 伤害修正x1.2
追踪泪弹
50%概率阻挡伤害
items.wiki_description: Spawns a white poop familiar, which turns into a White Poop when Isaac is hurt. White poop has an aura that increases tear fire rate and can block enemy shots. Category:Modified in Repentance The aura also increases damage by 20% and gives homing.

items.name: Pointy Rib
items.description_en:
Levitates in front of Isaac
Deals 6x Isaac's damage per second
items.description_zh:
漂浮在角色前方的骨刺
每秒造成6x角色伤害
items.wiki_description: Spawns a bone familiar that hovers back and forth in front of Isaac, dealing damage equal to Isaac's damage.

items.name: Book of the Dead
items.description_en: Spawns a bone orbital or friendly bony per enemy killed in the room (up to 8)
items.description_zh:
当前房间中每击杀1个敌人, 生成1个骨头环绕物/友好的骷髅仔
最多生成8个
items.wiki_description: Category:Modified in Repentance Creates a friendly Bony, Black Bony, or an orbital bone for each enemy killed in the current room. Category:Modified in Repentance Creates a friendly Bony, Black Bony, Bone Fly, Revenant, Big Bony, or an orbital bone for each enemy killed in the current room.

items.name: Dad's Ring
items.description_en: Grants an aura that petrifies enemies
items.description_zh: 获得能使敌人石化的光环
items.wiki_description: Creates a ring of light around Isaac that petrifies enemies in contact.

items.name: Divorce Papers
items.description_en:
+0.7 Tears
 +1 Bone Heart
 Spawns the Mysterious Paper trinket
items.description_zh:
射速+0.7
 +1骨心
 生成神秘纸片饰品
items.wiki_description: Grants one Bone Heart, +0.7 tears, spawns a Mysterious Paper .

items.name: Jaw Bone
items.description_en:
Boomerang-like familiar
Deals 7 contact damage
Can grab and bring back pickups
items.description_zh:
回旋镖状的跟班
造成7点接触伤害
能捡起并带回掉落物
items.wiki_description: Spawns a familiar that flies through the room while firing, dealing a flat 7 contact damage to enemies and retrieving pickups.

items.name: Brittle Bones
items.description_en:
Replaces all of Isaac's Red Heart containers with 6 empty Bone Hearts
Upon losing a Bone Heart:
 +0.4 Fire rate
Shoots 10 bone tears in all directions
items.description_zh:
角色所有的心之容器由6空骨心取代
失去骨心时:
 射速修正+0.4
向四周方向发射10颗骨头泪弹
items.wiki_description: Replaces all Red Heart Containers with 6 empty Bone Hearts. Category:Modified in Repentance Upon losing a Bone Heart, Isaac fires bones in 8 directions and permanently gains a tears up. Category:Modified in Repentance Upon losing a Bone Heart, Isaac fires bones in 8 directions and permanently gains a fire rate up.

items.name: Broken Shovel
items.description_en:
Mom's Foot constantly tries to stomp Isaac
Using the item stops the stomping for the room (or one Boss Rush wave)
 (Try to beat Boss Rush with it!)
items.description_zh:
妈腿会持续攻击角色
使用后, 在当前房间中(或头目车轮战1波次)妈腿攻击停止
 (试着带着它通过头目车轮战!)
items.wiki_description: While held, causes Mom to continuously attempt to stomp on Isaac. Activating makes her stop for the current room or wave. One of two parts necessary to create Mom's Shovel .

items.name: Broken Shovel
items.description_en:
Completes Mom's Shovel
 Use the shovel on the mound of dirt in the "Dark Room"
items.description_zh:
铲子碎片的第二部分
 在"暗室"的土丘上使用铲子
items.wiki_description: One of two parts necessary to create Mom's Shovel . No effect if somehow obtained on its own.

items.name: Mom's Shovel
items.description_en:
Spawns a trapdoor to the next floor
 Spawns a crawlspace if used on a decorative floor tile (grass, small rocks, papers, gems, etc.)
 Use the shovel on the mound of dirt in the "Dark Room"
items.description_zh:
生成通往下一层的活板门
 在有装饰(草/碎石/纸/宝石等)的地板上使用时, 改为生成暗门
 在"暗室"的土丘上使用铲子
items.wiki_description: Creates a trapdoor that leads to the next floor. Unlocks The Forgotten when used on a mound of dirt that appears in Dark Room.

items.name: Mucormycosis
items.description_en:
25% chance to shoot a sticky spore tear
 Not affected by luck
 Spores blow up after 2.5 seconds, dealing damage, poisoning nearby enemies and releasing more spores
items.description_zh:
25%概率发射粘性孢子泪弹
 不受幸运影响
孢子命中后2.5秒爆炸, 造成伤害, 使附近敌人中毒并释放更多孢子
items.wiki_description: Gives Isaac the chance to fire spore tears that stick to enemies and blow up after a few seconds, dealing damage and poisoning nearby enemies and releasing more spores.

items.name: 2Spooky
items.description_en:
+0.5 Fire rate
 +0.2 Shot speed
 Fears enemies in a small radius around Isaac
items.description_zh:
射速修正+0.5
 弹速+0.2
 使近距离的敌人恐惧
items.wiki_description: Enemies near Isaac are afflicted with fear. Category:Modified in Repentance+ Grants +0.5 tears and +0.2 shot speed.

items.name: Golden Razor
items.description_en:
+5 coins on pickup
 Pay 5 coins and receive for the room:
 +1.2 Damage
items.description_zh:
拾起时+5硬币
 花费5硬币, 并在当前房间中获得:
 伤害+1.2
items.wiki_description: Spends 5 pennies to grant +1.2 damage for the current room. Grants 5 pennies when picked up for the first time.

items.name: Sulfur
items.description_en:
Brimstone for the room
Using it multiple times in one room grants increased damage and a larger beam
items.description_zh:
在当前房间中获得硫磺火
多次使用使伤害更高, 激光更大
items.wiki_description: Grants Brimstone for the current room.

items.name: Fortune Cookie
items.description_en:
Grants one of the following rewards:
A fortune
 A Soul Heart
 A Rune or Soul Stone
 A Tarot card
 A Trinket
items.description_zh:
获得其一:
1条预言
 1魂心
 1符文/魂石
 1塔罗牌
 1饰品
items.wiki_description: Gives Isaac a fortune, Soul Heart, Card, Rune, or trinket, similar to a Fortune Telling Machine. Fortunes are much more likely to be given than anything else.

items.name: Eye Sore
items.description_en:
Chance to shoot 1-3 extra tears in random directions
 Not affected by luck
items.description_zh:
概率向随机方向发射1-3颗额外泪弹
 不受幸运影响
items.wiki_description: Causes Isaac to occasionally fire extra tears in random directions while shooting.

items.name: 120 Volt
items.description_en:
Repeatedly zaps nearby enemies
 Electricity deals up to 3.75x Isaac's damage per second
Sparks can arc to up to 4 other enemies
items.description_zh:
反复电击附近敌人
 电击每秒造成3.75x角色伤害
电弧可电穿最多4个其他敌人
items.wiki_description: Repeatedly zaps enemies that are close to Isaac.

items.name: It Hurts
items.description_en:
When taking damage, receive for the room:
 +1.2 Fire rate on the first hit
 +0.4 Fire rate for each additional hit
Releases a ring of 10 tears around Isaac
Tears leave a pool of creep on impact
items.description_zh:
受伤时, 在当前房间中获得:
 首次受伤射速修正+1.2
 后续受伤射速修正+0.4
在角色周围释放10颗泪弹
泪弹击中时留下水迹
items.wiki_description: Releases a ring of tears and increases fire rate for the current room when Isaac takes damage. Category:Modified in Repentance+ Isaac's tears also leave pools of red creep for the rest of the room.

items.name: Almond Milk
items.quote: DMG down + tears up + you feel nutty
items.description_en:
x4 Fire rate multiplier
 x0.3 Damage multiplier
 -0.16 Tear size
Tears gain random worm trinket effects and some item effects
items.description_zh:
射速修正x4
 伤害修正x0.3
 泪弹尺寸-0.16
泪弹随机获得蠕虫饰品和一些道具的效果
items.wiki_description: Quadruples fire rate, with ×0.3 damage multiplier. Each tear is given a random effect that alters its movement.

items.name: Rock Bottom
items.description_en: Prevents stats from being lowered for the rest of the run
items.description_zh: 本局游戏中属性不会再降低
items.wiki_description: Prevents Isaac's attributes from being lowered.

items.name: Nancy Bombs
items.description_en:
+5 Bombs
Isaac's bombs explode with random effects
items.description_zh:
+5炸弹
炸弹具有随机爆炸效果
items.wiki_description: +5 Bombs. Each bomb gains 1-4 random bomb synergies.

items.name: A Bar of Soap
items.description_en:
+0.5 Tears
 +0.2 Shot speed
items.wiki_description: +0.5 Tears, +0.2 Shot Speed.

items.name: Blood Puppy
items.description_en:
Chases enemies
After killing 15 enemies, it deals more damage, spawns a half Red Heart every 10 kills, but tries to hurt Isaac
After killing 40 enemies, it deals even more damage, spawns full Red Hearts, and can destroy rocks
Dealing enough damage to it returns it to its first phase
items.description_zh:
追击敌人
击杀15个敌人后, 会造成更多伤害, 每击杀10个敌人掉落半红心, 但也会尝试对角色造成伤害
击杀40个敌人后, 会造成更多伤害, 掉落整红心, 可以摧毁石头
对其造成足够多伤害可使其回到第一阶段
items.wiki_description: Spawns a familiar that chases enemies. After killing enough enemies, it becomes more powerful but will also try to hurt Isaac. Dealing enough damage to it returns it to normal.

items.name: Dream Catcher
items.description_en:
+1 half Soul Heart when entering a new floor
The stage transition nightmare reveals the next floor's boss fight and Treasure Room item
items.description_zh:
进入新层时+1半魂心
在每层过场噩梦中显示下一层的头目战和宝箱房道具
items.wiki_description: During the transition between floors, Isaac's nightmare shows the contents of the upcoming floor's Treasure Room, as well as the floor's boss. Grants a Half Soul Heart when entering a new floor.

items.name: Paschal Candle
items.description_en:
Clearing a room without taking damage grants +0.4 Fire rate
Caps at +2 Fire rate (5 rooms)
items.description_zh:
若清理房间且不受伤害, 则射速修正+0.4
最多+2(5个房间)
items.wiki_description: Gives Isaac a familiar that grants +0.4 Fire Rate for each consecutive room he's cleared without taking damage. The bonus stacks up to five times.

items.name: Divine Intervention
items.description_en:
Double-tapping a fire key creates a shield
The shield lasts 1 second, pushes enemies away and reflects enemy projectiles and lasers
items.description_zh:
双击发射键产生护盾
护盾持续1秒, 能推开敌人, 反弹敌人弹幕和激光
items.wiki_description: Double tapping a fire key creates a shield that pushes away enemies and reflects enemy projectiles and lasers.

items.name: Blood Oath
items.description_en:
Entering a new floor drains all of Isaac's Red Hearts, but grants speed and damage bonuses for each heart lost
Each half heart lost counts as an individual hit for on-hit effects
items.description_zh:
进入新层时, 吸走角色的所有红心, 但根据失去的红心获得移速和伤害加成
致死时保留半红心
对于受击效果, 每失去半红心都算作单独一击
items.wiki_description: Stabs Isaac at the beginning of each floor, draining his Red Hearts. Increases damage and speed for the floor based on the amount drained.

items.name: Playdough Cookie
items.description_en: Each of Isaac's tears have a different color and status effect
items.description_zh: 角色的每颗泪弹都有不同的颜色和效果
items.wiki_description: Grants multicolored tears. Each color comes with a different status or tear effect.

items.name: Orphan Socks
items.quote: Speed up + your feet feel stronger
items.description_en:
+0.3 Speed
 +2 Soul Hearts
Immune to creep and floor spikes
items.description_zh:
移速+0.3
 +2魂心
免疫水迹和地刺
items.wiki_description: Prevents creep and floor spikes from damaging Isaac. Also gives Isaac +0.3 speed and 2 Soul Hearts.

items.name: Eye of the Occult
items.quote: DMG up + range up + controlled tears
items.description_en:
+1 Damage
 +2 Range
 -0.16 Shot speed
Isaac's tears can be controlled in mid-air
items.description_zh:
伤害+1
 射程+2
 弹速-0.16
角色的泪弹飞行时可控
items.wiki_description: +1 damage, +2 range, -0.16 shot speed. Isaac's tears can be controlled mid-flight with tear controls.

items.name: Immaculate Heart
items.description_en:
+1 Health
 x1.2 Damage multiplier
 Full health
20% chance to shoot an extra orbiting spectral tear
items.description_zh:
+1心之容器
 伤害修正x1.2
 回满血
20%概率额外发射1颗环绕灵体泪弹
items.wiki_description: Adds one Red Heart Container and fully restores health. x1.2 damage multiplier. Isaac will occasionally fire extra tears that orbit around him.

items.name: Monstrance
items.description_en:
Isaac is surrounded by a damaging aura
The closer enemies are to Isaac, the more damage the aura deals to them
items.description_zh:
角色获得造成伤害的光环
敌人越靠近角色, 光环造成的伤害越高
items.wiki_description: Isaac gains an aura that deals damage to enemies inside it.

items.name: The Intruder
items.description_en:
Buries itself in Isaac's head and shoots 4 extra slowing tears that deal 1.5 damage
Taking damage has a 25% chance to make the spider exit the head and chase enemies
items.description_zh:
蜘蛛埋在角色头里, 额外发射4颗减速泪弹, 造成1.5点伤害
受伤时, 蜘蛛有25%概率离开头并追击敌人
items.wiki_description: A familiar burrows in Isaac's head, firing 4 slowing tears. Upon taking damage, there's a chance it will burst out of Isaac's head, spawning blue spiders and chasing enemies for the current room.

items.name: Dirty Mind
items.description_en:
All Dip (small poop) enemies are friendly
Destroying poop spawns 1-4 Dips
Dip type depends on the poop type
Rocks have a 6.25% chance to be replaced with poop
items.description_zh:
所有粪滴敌人变得友好
摧毁大便时, 生成1-4个粪滴
粪滴类型取决于大便类型
石头有6.25%概率会由大便取代
items.wiki_description: Destroying poop spawns Dip Familiars that follow Isaac and damage enemies. Destroying different types of poop spawns different Dips with special effects.

items.name: Damocles
items.quote: A king's fortune... but at what cost?
items.description_en:
Hangs a sword above Isaac's head, which doubles all pedestal items
Does not double items that have a price or come from chests
 After taking any damage, the sword has an extremely low chance to instantly kill Isaac every frame
Invincibility effects can prevent the death
items.description_zh:
在角色头上悬着剑, 并使底座道具翻倍
有价格或箱子中的道具不翻倍
 受伤后, 剑每帧有极低概率立即击杀角色
无敌效果可以避免死亡
items.wiki_description: Spawns a sword above Isaac's head, which doubles all item pedestals. After Isaac takes damage, the sword can randomly fall at any point, instantly killing him.

items.name: Free Lemonade
items.description_en:
Creates a large pool of yellow creep
The creep deals 24 damage per second
items.description_zh:
生成大范围的黄色水迹
水迹每秒造成24点伤害
items.wiki_description: Creates a large pool of yellow creep beneath Isaac.

items.name: Spirit Sword
items.description_en:
Instead of shooting tears, swing a sword
 The sword deals 3x Isaac's damage +3.5 and swings as fast as the fire button is tapped
 Charging does a spin attack + projectile shot
Shoots projectiles with swings at full health
items.description_zh:
攻击方式改为挥剑
 剑造成3x角色伤害+3.5的伤害, 挥剑速度与按发射键速度一样快
 可蓄力发动旋转攻击
满血时发射剑气
items.wiki_description: Instead of tears, Isaac swings a sword. Charging does a spin attack and fires a projectile, and a projectile is sometimes fired with normal swings if Isaac has no empty Red Heart Containers.

items.name: Red Key
items.description_en:
Creates a red room adjacent to a regular room, indicated by a door outline
Red Rooms can be special rooms
 Entering a room outside the 13x13 floor map teleports Isaac to the I AM ERROR room
items.description_zh:
在常规房间旁产生门形轮廓指示的红色房间
红色房间可以是特殊房间
 进入13x13地图范围外的房间时, 将角色传送至错误房
items.wiki_description: Creates a Red Room adjacent to a viable wall, indicated by the outline of a door. These rooms have a 10% chance to be a special room.

items.name: Psy Fly
items.description_en:
Chases and blocks enemy projectiles
Deals 15 contact damage per second
items.description_zh:
追击并阻挡敌人弹幕
每秒造成15点接触伤害
items.wiki_description: Spawns a fly orbital familiar that seeks out incoming enemy shots and destroys them.

items.name: Wavy Cap
items.quote: Tears up. A mind changing experience!
items.description_en:
+0.75 Fire rate
 -0.03 Speed
Distorts the screen
Takes longer to recharge each use
Leaving or clearing rooms reduces the effects
items.description_zh:
射速修正+0.75
 移速-0.03
扭曲画面
每次使用后延长充能时间
离开或清理房间可减弱效果
items.wiki_description: Increases tears, decreases speed, and distorts the screen. All effects become more pronounced with repeated use, and wear off by clearing rooms.

items.name: Rocket in a Jar
items.description_en:
+5 Bombs
Placing a bomb while shooting fires a rocket in that direction instead
items.description_zh:
+5炸弹
发射时放置炸弹, 炸弹由发射火箭取代
items.wiki_description: +5 Bombs. If Isaac is currently firing, placing a bomb will instead shoot a fast-moving, explosive rocket in the direction he's facing.

items.name: Book of Virtues
items.description_en:
+12.5% Angel Room chance while held
Spawns an orbital wisp familiar that shoots spectral tears but can be destroyed
Can be combined with a second active item to create special wisps
 Turns the first Devil Room into an Angel Room
 Allows Angel Rooms to spawn after taking a Devil deal
items.description_zh:
持有时, 天使房概率+12.5%
生成1魂火环绕跟班, 发射灵体泪弹但可被摧毁
与其它主动道具组合可产生特殊魂火
 将第一个恶魔房变为天使房
 恶魔交易后仍会出现天使房
items.wiki_description: Passively causes active items to spawn themed orbital wisp familiars on use, which fire tears and block shots. Can be activated to spawn a basic wisp if Isaac has no other active item.

items.name: Alabaster Box
items.description_en:
Must be charged by picking up Soul Hearts, then spawns:
 Three Soul Hearts
 Two Angel Room items
 Only spawns 2 Soul Hearts and 1 Angel item if a Devil deal was taken previously
items.description_zh:
必须通过拾起魂心充能, 使用时生成:
 3魂心
 2个天使房道具
 若已进行过恶魔交易, 则改为2魂心和1个天使房道具
items.wiki_description: Upon use, spawns three Soul Hearts and two Angel Room items and is consumed. Starts with no charges, and can only be charged by picking up 6 Soul Hearts.

items.name: The Stairway
items.quote: May you get what you came for
items.description_en: Spawns a ladder in the first room of every floor that leads to a unique Angel Room shop with items and pickups
items.description_zh: 在每层的初始房间生成梯子, 通向特殊天使房商店
items.wiki_description: Generates a ladder at the start of every floor that leads to a unique Angel Room shop.

items.name: Sol
items.description_en:
Reveals the location of the Boss Room
 When the floor boss is defeated, receive for the floor:
 +3 Damage
 +1 Luck
 The Sun effect
 Fully recharges the active item
 Removes any curses
items.description_zh:
揭示头目房位置
 击败头目后, 在本层获得:
 伤害+3
 幸运+1
 太阳的效果
 将主动道具完全充能
 移除诅咒
items.wiki_description: Reveals the location of the Boss Room. Upon defeating a boss, activates XIX - The Sun , fully recharges Isaac's active item, grants bonus damage and luck for the rest of the floor, and removes curses.

items.name: Luna
items.quote: The moon's blessing shines upon you
items.description_en:
Adds an extra Secret Room and Super Secret Room to each floor
Reveals one Secret Room each floor
 Secret Rooms contain a beam of light that grant for the floor:
 +0.5 Fire rate
 Additional +0.5 Fire rate from the first beam per floor
 Half a Soul Heart
items.description_zh:
每层额外增加1个隐藏房和超级隐藏房
每层揭示1个隐藏房
 隐藏房内有光束, 接触时在本层获得:
 射速修正+0.5
 每层首个光柱额外+0.5射速修正
 1半魂心
items.wiki_description: Adds an extra Secret Room and Super Secret Room to each floor. Secret Rooms contain a beam of light that increases Fire Rate for the current floor and gives a Half Soul Heart.

items.name: Mercurius
items.description_en:
+0.4 Speed
Most doors stay permanently open
items.description_zh:
移速+0.4
大多数门会永久保持打开
items.wiki_description: +0.4 speed. Doors stay open after entering a room, even in rooms with enemies.

items.name: Venus
items.description_en:
+1 Health
 Heals 1 heart
 Charms nearby enemies
items.description_zh:
+1心之容器
 治疗1红心
 魅惑附近敌人
items.wiki_description: Adds one red Heart container. Heals 1 additional Red Heart. Enemies near Isaac become charmed.

items.name: Terra
items.description_en:
+1 Damage
Replaces Isaac's tears with rocks
Rocks deal variable damage, can destroy obstacles and have increased knockback
items.description_zh:
伤害+1
角色的泪弹由石头取代
石头伤害不定, 可摧毁障碍物并有更强的击退力
items.wiki_description: +1 Damage. Replaces tears with rocks that deal variable damage, have increased knockback, and can destroy obstacles.

items.name: Mars
items.description_en:
Double-tapping a movement key makes Isaac dash
 During a dash, Isaac is invincible and deals 4x his damage +8
 3 seconds cooldown
 Creates a ring of fire on impact
items.description_zh:
双击移动键使角色冲锋
 冲锋时角色无敌, 造成4x角色伤害+8的伤害
 3秒冷却
 撞击时在角色周围生成火圈
items.wiki_description: Dash by double-tapping the movement key, becoming invulnerable and damaging enemies. There's a short cooldown before Isaac can dash again. Category:Modified in Repentance+ Knocks away nearby enemies and briefly grants i-frames after dashing.

items.name: Jupiter
items.description_en:
+2 Empty heart containers
 -0.3 Speed
 Heals 2 heart
 Speed builds up to +0.5 while standing still
 Moving releases poison clouds
 Poison immunity
items.description_zh:
+2空心之容器
 移速-0.3
 治疗2红心
 静止不动时, 移速逐渐升高至+0.5
 移动时释放毒气
 免疫中毒
items.wiki_description: +2 red Heart containers, -0.3 speed. Isaac builds speed while standing still, and releases poison gas clouds when he moves afterwards.

items.name: Saturnus
items.description_en:
Entering a room causes 7 tears to orbit Isaac
Those tears last for 13 seconds and deal 1.5x Isaac's damage +5
Enemy projectiles have a chance to orbit Isaac
items.description_zh:
进入房间时生成7颗泪弹在角色周围环绕
这些泪弹持续13秒, 造成1.5x角色伤害+5的伤害
敌人弹幕有概率加入环绕
items.wiki_description: Upon entering a room, a circle of 7 tears orbits Isaac, which last for 13 seconds before falling to the ground. Enemy tears have a chance to be caught in orbit, turning them friendly.

items.name: Uranus
items.description_en:
Isaac shoots petrifying tears that freeze enemies on death
Touching a frozen enemy makes it slide away and explode into 10 ice shards
items.description_zh:
角色发射冰冻泪弹, 击杀敌人时使其冻结
可以推开冻结的敌人, 撞碎时向四周发射10个冰锥
items.wiki_description: Isaac shoots ice tears, which slow enemies and freeze monsters they kill. Frozen enemies slide away and explode into ice shards when touched.

items.name: Neptunus
items.description_en:
Not shooting builds up a tear bonus over 3 seconds
The tear bonus decreases as Isaac shoots
items.description_zh:
不发射时3秒内累积射速加成
角色发射时降低射速加成
items.wiki_description: Isaac's mouth fills with tears over time while not firing, up to a cap. Holding the fire button will release all stored tears in rapid succession.

items.name: Pluto
items.description_en:
+0.7 Tears
Significantly shrinks Isaac, allowing him to squeeze between objects
Projectiles can pass over him
items.description_zh:
射速+0.7
角色大幅缩小, 允许挤过物体
弹幕可以越过角色
items.wiki_description: +0.7 tears. Significantly shrinks Isaac, allowing him to squeeze between objects and makes some enemy shots pass over him.

items.name: Voodoo Head
items.description_en:
Spawns an additional Curse Room each floor
Improves Curse Room layouts and rewards
 Spawns a coin in every Curse Room
items.description_zh:
每层额外生成1个诅咒房
升级诅咒房的布局和奖励
 每个诅咒房生成1硬币
items.wiki_description: Spawns an additional Curse Room on each floor. Curse Rooms have improved layouts.

items.name: Eye Drops
items.description_en: x1.4 Fire rate multiplier for the left eye
items.description_zh: 左眼射速修正x1.4
items.wiki_description: Increases the fire rate in Isaac's left eye, causing his eyes to fire at different rates.

items.name: Act of Contrition
items.description_en:
+0.7 Tears
 +1 Eternal Heart
 Allows Angel Rooms to spawn even after taking a devil deal
Taking Red Heart damage doesn't reduce Devil/Angel Room chance as much
items.description_zh:
射速+0.7
 +1永恒之心
 进行过恶魔交易后天使房仍然会出现
 减缓受红心伤害后减少恶魔房/天使房的概率
items.wiki_description: +0.7 tears, grants an Eternal Heart. Allows Angel Rooms to appear even if a Devil Deal has been taken before. Reduces the Devil/Angel room chance penalty for taking Red heart damage.

items.name: Member Card
items.description_en:
Opens a trapdoor in every Shop
The trapdoor leads to an underground shop that sells trinkets, runes, cards, special hearts and items from any pool
items.description_zh: 在商店内生成1个通往地下商店的暗门, 售卖饰品, 符文, 卡牌, 特殊心和任意道具池的道具
items.wiki_description: Adds a trapdoor to every Shop that leads to a second shop with a unique stock and marked-up prices.

items.name: Battery Pack
items.description_en:
Spawns 2-4 batteries
 Fully recharges the active item
items.description_zh:
生成2-4电池
 将主动道具完全充能
items.wiki_description: Recharges Isaac's currently held active item and drops 2-4 batteries.

items.name: Mom's Bracelet
items.description_en:
Allows Isaac to pick up and throw rocks, TNT, poops, friendly Dips, Hosts and other obstacles
Allows carrying them between rooms
items.description_zh:
允许角色举起并投掷石头/TNT/大便/友好粪滴/寄居骷髅等障碍物
举起的东西可以带到其他房间
items.wiki_description: Lets Isaac pick up and throw rocks, TNT, Poops, friendly Dips, Bombs, and other obstacles.

items.name: The Scooper
items.description_en:
x1.35 Damage multiplier for the right eye
 Summons a Peeper familiar for the room, which leaves a trail of red creep and deals 36 contact damage per second
items.description_zh:
右眼伤害修正x1.35
 在当前房间中召唤1个眼球跟班, 每秒造成36点伤害并留下血迹
items.wiki_description: Summons The Peeper for the current room, which leaves a trail of red creep.

items.name: Ocular Rift
items.description_en:
5% chance to shoot tears that create rifts where they land
 20% chance at 15 luck
Rifts do 3x Isaac's damage per second and pull in nearby enemies, pickups, and projectiles
items.description_zh:
5%概率发射在落地时生成裂隙的泪弹
 幸运15: 20%概率
裂隙每秒造成3x角色伤害, 并吸引附近的敌人, 掉落物和弹幕
items.wiki_description: Adds a chance to fire tears that create rifts where they land, which suck enemies, pickups, and shots towards them and damage enemies in the area.

items.name: Boiled Baby
items.description_en:
Shoots chaotic bursts of tears in all directions
Deals 3.5 or 5.25 damage per tear
items.description_zh:
向四周随机喷射泪弹
泪弹造成3.5或5.25点伤害
items.wiki_description: Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac around and fires chaotic bursts of tears in all directions.

items.name: Freezer Baby
items.description_en:
Shoots petrifying tears that deal 3.5 damage
 Freezes enemies upon killing them
items.description_zh:
发射石化泪弹, 造成3.5点伤害
 击杀时使敌人冻结
items.wiki_description: Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac around and fires icicles have a chance to petrify enemies and freeze monsters they kill.

items.name: Eternal D6
items.description_en:
Rerolls all pedestal items in the room
Has a 25% chance to delete items instead of rerolling them
items.description_zh:
重置房间中所有道具
25%概率删除道具而不是重置
items.wiki_description: Re-rolls all items in the room. Each item has a 25% chance to disappear instead.

items.name: Bird Cage
items.description_en:
Leaps on the enemy that deals the first damage to Isaac in a room
Deals 45 damage and releases a rock wave
Chases enemies afterwards for 6.5 contact damage per second
items.description_zh:
角色在房间中首次受伤时, 跃向敌人
造成45点伤害并释放岩石波
之后追击敌人, 每秒造成6.5点接触伤害
items.wiki_description: The first time Isaac takes damage in a room, a familiar leaps on an enemy, dealing damage and releasing a rock wave. For the rest of the room, it chases enemies similar to Dead Bird .

items.name: Larynx
items.description_en:
Isaac screams, damages and knocks back nearby enemies
The scream gets stronger the more charges the item has
items.description_zh:
角色怒吼, 击退周围的敌人并造成伤害
充能越多, 怒吼效果越强
items.wiki_description: Isaac shouts, damaging and pushing away nearby enemies. The shout gets stronger the more charges the item has. Larynx gains 1 charge whenever Isaac takes damage, in addition to charging normally.

items.name: Lost Soul
items.description_en:
Dies in one hit and respawns at the start of the next floor
If it is brought alive to the next floor, it can spawn:
 3 Soul Hearts
 2 Eternal Hearts
 A Treasure Room item
 An Angel Room item
items.description_zh:
受伤时死亡, 会在下一层重生
如果存活时带到下一层, 可能生成:
 3魂心
 2永恒之心
 1个宝箱房道具
 1个天使房道具
items.wiki_description: Creates a ghostly familiar that closely follows behind Isaac. It dies in one hit, but respawns at the start of the next floor. Each time it survives until the next floor, it rewards Isaac with Soul Hearts, Eternal Hearts, or an Item.

items.name: Blood Bombs
items.description_en:
+1 Health
 Heals 4 hearts
 If Isaac has no bombs, one can be placed at the cost of half a heart
Isaac's bombs leave red creep
items.description_zh:
+1心之容器
 治疗4红心
 若角色没有炸弹, 则可以花费半心放置炸弹
角色的炸弹会留下血迹
items.wiki_description: Grants a Red Heart container and restores 5 hearts. Bombs leave behind damaging red creep. Isaac can place Bombs at the cost of half a heart if he doesn't have any.

items.name: Lil Dumpy
items.description_en:
Deflects an enemy or projectile right before Isaac would take damage from it
Needs to be touched after deflecting to be reactivated
items.description_zh:
角色即将受伤时, 弹开敌人或弹幕
弹开后需要触碰才能再次激活
items.wiki_description: Spawns a Dumpy familiar that pushes away nearby enemies and projectiles just before Isaac is about to be hit, then falls asleep. He can be awoken by walking to him.

items.name: Bird's Eye
items.description_en:
8% chance to shoot a red fire that blocks enemy shots and deals contact damage
 50% chance at 10 luck
Fires disappear after blocking 4 shots, dealing damage 4 times or after 10 seconds
items.description_zh:
8%概率发射红火, 阻挡敌人弹幕并造成接触伤害
 幸运10: 50%概率
火焰造成或阻挡4次伤害后或10秒后消失
items.wiki_description: Gives a chance to shoot fires alongside tears that block enemy shots and deal damage to enemies that touch them.

items.name: Lodestone
items.description_en:
17% chance to shoot magnetizing tears
 100% chance at 5 luck
Magnetized enemies attract nearby pickups, projectiles and enemies
items.description_zh:
17%概率发射使敌人磁化的泪弹
 运气5: 100%概率
磁化的敌人吸引掉落物, 弹幕和其它敌人
items.wiki_description: Gives Isaac the chance to fire tears that magnetize enemies they hit, causing them to attract nearby pickups and enemies, as well as tears/shots from all sources.

items.name: Rotten Tomato
items.description_en:
17% chance to shoot tears that mark enemies
 100% chance at 5 luck
Marked enemies are targeted by other enemies
items.description_zh:
17%概率发射标记敌人的泪弹
 运气5: 100%概率
被标记的敌人会被其他敌人攻击
items.wiki_description: Adds a chance to fire tears that mark enemies with the Bait status effect. Enemies marked as bait are attacked by other enemies.

items.name: Birthright
items.description_en: Has a different effect for each character
items.description_zh: 不同角色效果不同
items.wiki_description: Grants a character-specific effect that enhances their special abilities.

items.name: Red Stew
items.description_en:
+21.6 Damage
 Full health
The damage up wears off over 3 minutes
Killing enemies while the effect is active extends it
items.description_zh:
伤害+21.6
 回满血
增加的伤害在3分钟内会不断衰减
效果尚存时击杀敌人会延长时间
items.wiki_description: Refills all heart containers. Grants an enormous damage boost that wears off over time.

items.name: Genesis
items.description_en:
Removes all of Isaac's items and pickups
Teleports Isaac to a bedroom with pickups and chests
For every item removed, Isaac can choose between 3 items from the same pool
Leaving the bedroom takes Isaac to the next floor
items.description_zh:
移除角色的所有道具和掉落物
将角色传送至特殊的卧室, 内有掉落物和箱子
每移除1个道具, 角色就可从来自相同道具池的3个道具选择
离开卧室时, 将角色带到下一层
items.wiki_description: Removes all of Isaac's items and pickups and takes him to a unique Clean Bedroom with some pickups and Chests and a passage to the next floor. For every item Isaac lost, he gets to take an item from a set of three.

items.name: Sharp Key
items.description_en:
+5 Keys
Throws one of Isaac's keys in the direction he shoots
Thrown keys deal damage, destroy obstacles, and open doors
Enemies killed with keys can spawn the contents of a chest, including items
items.description_zh:
+5钥匙
向角色发射方向投掷角色的1钥匙
投掷的钥匙可造成伤害, 摧毁障碍物或开门
被钥匙击杀的敌人有概率掉落箱子里的物品, 包括道具
items.wiki_description: Adds 5 Keys on pickup. Allows Isaac to throw his keys to deal damage to enemies, destroy obstacles, and open doors.

items.name: Booster Pack
items.description_en: Spawns 5 random cards
items.description_zh: 生成5随机卡牌
items.wiki_description: Drops 5 random cards.

items.name: Mega Mush
items.description_en:
Gigantifies Isaac and grants:
 x4 Damage multiplier
 +2 Range
 -1.9 Tears
Invincibility
Ability to crush enemies and obstacles
 Lasts for 30 seconds and persists between rooms and floors
items.description_zh:
角色巨化并获得:
 伤害修正x4
 射程+2
 射速-1.9
无敌
能踩碎障碍物和敌人
 持续30秒, 能在房间之间和层之间持续
items.wiki_description: Gigantifies Isaac for 30 seconds, increasing damage and range while lowering tears, granting invulnerability, and allowing Isaac to crush enemies and obstacles he walks on. The effect persists between rooms.

items.name: Knife Piece 1
items.description_en:
Turns into a throwable knife that deals 25 damage when combined with Knife Piece 2
The knife can open a door made of flesh
items.description_zh:
与菜刀碎片2结合变为可投掷的菜刀, 造成25点伤害
菜刀能打开红色肉门
items.wiki_description: Combined with Knife Piece 2 , creates a knife familiar that damages enemies and can open the door to the Corpse.

items.name: Knife Piece 2
items.description_en:
Turns into a throwable knife that deals 25 damage when combined with Knife Piece 1
The knife can open a door made of flesh
items.description_zh:
与菜刀碎片1结合变为可投掷的菜刀, 造成25点伤害
菜刀能打开红色肉门
items.wiki_description: Combined with Knife Piece 1 , creates a knife familiar that damages enemies and can open the door to the Corpse.

items.name: Death Certificate
items.description_en:
Teleports Isaac to a floor that contains every item in the game
Choosing an item from this floor teleports Isaac back to the room he came from
items.description_zh:
将角色传送至含有所有游戏道具的一层
拾起1个道具后回到之前的房间
items.wiki_description: Transports Isaac to an abandoned and expanded version of Home, which contains one copy of every item in the game. After taking an item, Isaac returns to the room he used Death Certificate in.

items.name: Bot Fly
items.description_en:
Shoots shielded tears to destroy enemy projectiles
Deals 3 contact damage per second
items.description_zh:
发射能摧毁敌人弹幕的护盾泪弹
每秒造成3点接触伤害
items.wiki_description: Spawns an orbiting fly familiar that fires shielded tears at incoming enemy projectiles.

items.name: Meat Cleaver
items.description_en:
Splits all enemies in the room into 2 smaller versions with 40% health
Enemies that naturally split (like Envy) take enough damage to split instead
Deals 25 damage to enemies that can't be split
items.description_zh:
使敌人分裂为2个40%血量的小型版本
本身能分裂的敌人(比如嫉妒)改为造成分裂所需的伤害
对无法分裂的敌人造成25点伤害
items.wiki_description: Splits all enemies in the room into two smaller versions of themselves with much less health.

items.name: Evil Charm
items.description_en:
+2 Luck
Immune to fire damage, confusion, fear, spider-webs and poison effects
Grants 1 second immunity to creep
items.description_zh:
幸运+2
免疫火焰伤害, 混乱, 恐惧, 蜘蛛网, 毒气效果
获得1秒水迹免疫
items.wiki_description: +2 luck. Provides immunity to burn, confusion, fear, and poison. Category:Modified in Repentance+ Prevents slowdown from cobwebs, and allows Isaac to stand in enemy creep for 1 second before taking damage.

items.name: Dogma
items.description_en:
+0.1 Speed
 +2 Damage
Flight and one-time Holy Mantle shield
 Heals Isaac with Red and Soul Hearts if he has less than 6 hearts
items.description_zh:
移速+0.1
 伤害+2
飞行, 单次神圣屏障护盾
 若角色少于6心, 则以红心和魂心治疗至6心
items.wiki_description: Grants flight, +2 damage, and increases speed to 1.1. Grants enough health to have 6 full hearts, if possible. Grants the Holy Mantle effect for the room it was obtained in. Automatically given to Isaac after defeating Dogma.

items.name: Purgatory
items.description_en:
Red cracks spawn on the ground in hostile rooms
Walking over the cracks summons homing exploding ghosts
items.description_zh:
在有敌人的房间中的地面生成红色裂缝
走过裂缝时会召唤追踪爆炸幽灵
items.wiki_description: While in a room with enemies, spawns red cracks in the ground. Walking over these cracks summons ghosts that launch themselves at enemies and explode.

items.name: Stitches
items.description_en:
Spawns a familiar that moves in the direction Isaac shoots
On use, Isaac swaps places with the familiar and becomes briefly invincible
Teleporting onto things can damage or destroy them
items.description_zh:
生成1个跟班, 向角色发射方向移动
使用时, 角色与跟班互换位置, 并短暂无敌
传送到物体上可以造成伤害或将其摧毁
items.wiki_description: Passively spawns a familiar that moves in the direction Isaac shoots. On use, Isaac swaps places with the familiar.

items.name: R Key
items.description_en:
Restarts the entire run
All items, trinkets, stats and pickups collected are kept
The timer does not reset
items.description_zh:
整局重新开始
已收集的道具, 饰品, 属性和掉落物保留
计时器不重置
items.wiki_description: Returns Isaac back to the first floor of a new run, retaining all of his stats and items.

items.name: Knockout Drops
items.description_en:
10% chance to shoot a fist that inflicts confusion and extreme knockback
 100% chance at 9 luck
Enemies take damage when they get knocked into a wall/obstacle
items.description_zh:
10%概率发射拳头, 对敌人造成强力击退和混乱
 运气9: 100%概率
撞到墙/障碍物的敌人会受到伤害
items.wiki_description: Adds a chance to shoot a fist tear that has extremely high knockback and confuses enemies.

items.name: Eraser
items.description_en:
Throws an eraser that instantly kills an enemy
Prevents the erased enemy from spawning for the rest of the run
Deals 15 damage to bosses
Can only be used once per floor
items.description_zh:
掷出橡皮, 秒杀击中的敌人
击杀的敌人在本局游戏中不会再出现
对头目造成15点伤害
每层只能使用一次
items.wiki_description: Throws an eraser that instantly kills the first monster it hits, and prevents that enemy from spawning for the rest of the run. Deals 15 damage to bosses, erasing the boss from the rest of the run if damage is fatal. Only recharges upon entering a new floor.

items.name: Yuck Heart
items.description_en: +1 Rotten Heart
items.description_zh: +1腐心
items.wiki_description: Grants Isaac a Rotten Heart.

items.name: Urn of Souls
items.description_en:
Spews a stream of flames
Killing an enemy adds a charge to the urn
items.description_zh:
喷射火焰
击杀1个敌人, 瓮增加1格充能
items.wiki_description: Isaac pulls out or puts away an urn that fires a stream of damaging blue flames. It gains Soul Charges each time an enemy dies, which are used to fuel the urn.

items.name: Akeldama
items.description_en:
Creates a chain of tears behind Isaac in hostile rooms
The tears deal 3.5 damage
items.description_zh:
在有敌人的房间中, 在角色身后产生一串泪弹
泪弹造成3.5点伤害
items.wiki_description: While in an uncleared room, Isaac forms a trail of bloody tears that drags behind him, bursting and dealing damage upon contact with enemies.

items.name: Magic Skin
items.description_en:
Spawns an item from the current room's item pool
 Turns 1 heart container or 1 Bone Heart or 2 Soul Hearts into a Broken Heart
 Replaces future items if Isaac isn't holding it (33% after 1 use, 50% after 2, 100% after 3)
Lower chance if Magic Skin is on a pedestal on the current floor
items.description_zh:
生成当前房间道具池的1个道具
将1心之容器/1骨心/2魂心变为1碎心
生成当前房间道具池的1个道具
 若角色不再持有, 则有概率将后续道具替换(1次使用后33%, 2次后50%, 3次后100%)
若玄奇驴皮在本层道具底座上, 则降低概率
items.wiki_description: Consumes one heart container or two Soul Hearts to spawn an item and grant Isaac a broken heart container that can never be filled. If Magic Skin is not held after being used, it is very likely to replace any future items.

items.name: Revelation
items.description_en:
Flight
 Chargeable high damage holy beam
Does not replace Isaac's tears
items.description_zh:
飞行
 可蓄力发射高伤害圣光柱
不会取代角色的泪弹
items.wiki_description: Grants flight. In addition to tears, Isaac can charge up and fire a powerful holy laser. Category:Modified in AfterbirthCategory:Modified in Repentance+ Also grants two Soul Hearts.

items.name: Consolation Prize
items.description_en:
Increases Isaac's lowest stat out of Speed, Fire rate, Damage, and Range
Spawns either 3 coins, 1 bomb, or 1 key depending on what Isaac has the least of
items.description_zh:
提升角色移速/射速/伤害/射程中最低的属性
根据角色持有的最少掉落物, 生成3硬币/1炸弹/1钥匙
items.wiki_description: Increases Isaac's lowest stat and drops either 3 Coins, 1 Bomb, or 1 Key depending on what Isaac has the least of.

items.name: Tinytoma
items.description_en:
Large orbital that blocks shots
Deals 3.5 contact damage per second
Splits into smaller versions of itself upon taking 3 hits
The smaller versions break into blue spiders
Respawns 5 seconds after fully disappearing
items.description_zh:
阻挡弹幕的大型环绕物
每秒造成3.5点接触伤害
受击3次时, 分裂为更小的畸胎瘤
小畸胎瘤被摧毁时产生蓝蜘蛛
被完全摧毁时, 5秒后重生
items.wiki_description: Gives Isaac a Teratoma orbital that blocks shots, deals contact damage, and splits into smaller versions of itself upon taking damage. The smaller versions break into blue spiders.

items.name: Brimstone Bombs
items.description_en:
+5 Bombs
 Isaac's bombs release a 4-way blood beam
The beams don't hurt Isaac
items.description_zh:
+5炸弹
 角色的炸弹爆炸时, 释放十字血柱
血柱不会伤到角色
items.wiki_description: +5 Bombs. Bombs fire four Brimstone lasers in the cardinal directions upon exploding.

items.name: 4.5 Volt
items.quote: Beat the juice out of them!
items.description_en:
Clearing rooms no longer charges active items
Dealing damage to enemies slowly fills up the charge bar
Damage needed per charge increases each floor
items.description_zh:
清理房间不再对主动道具充能
对敌人造成伤害时缓慢充能
充能所需伤害量随层数提升
items.wiki_description: Active items don't charge when clearing rooms. Instead, they're charged by dealing damage to enemies.

items.name: Fruity Plum
items.description_en:
Propels herself diagonally around the room, firing tears in her path that deal 3 damage
Deals 6 contact damage per second
items.description_zh:
在房间中斜角前进, 向路径上发射泪弹, 造成3点伤害
每秒造成6点接触伤害
items.wiki_description: Gives Isaac a miniature Baby Plum familiar that propels itself diagonally around the room, firing tears behind itself as it travels.

items.name: Plum Flute
items.description_en: Summons a friendly Baby Plum in the room for 10 seconds
items.description_zh: 在当前房间中召唤1只友好的糖梅宝宝, 持续10秒
items.wiki_description: Summons Baby Plum to fight for Isaac for roughly 10 seconds, dealing high damage.

items.name: Star of Bethlehem
items.description_en:
Slowly travels from the first room of the floor to the Boss Room
Moves faster if you're ahead of it, and slower if you're behind it
Standing in its aura grants:
 x2.5 Tears multiplier
 x1.2 Damage multiplier
Homing tears
50% chance to ignore damage
items.description_zh:
从本层初始房间向头目房缓慢移动
角色领先则移动加快, 角色落后则移动减慢
站在光环中获得:
 射速修正x2.5
 伤害修正x1.2
追踪泪弹
50%概率忽略伤害
items.wiki_description: Spawns a star familiar that slowly travels towards the Boss Room, giving an aura that increases damage and tears and grants homing tears.

items.name: Cube Baby
items.description_en:
Can be kicked around by walking into it
 Slows and deals up to 17.5 contact damage depending on speed
 Freezes enemies it kills
items.description_zh:
经过时可踢开
 使敌人减速, 根据速度造成最多17.5点接触伤害
 击杀时使敌人冻结
items.wiki_description: Spawns an ice cube familiar that slides around when walked into. It slows and deals contact damage, freezing monsters it kills.

items.name: Vade Retro
items.description_en:
Holding the item causes non-ghost enemies to spawn small red ghosts on death
Using the item causes the ghosts to explode
Using the item also kills any ghost enemies (including bosses) that have less than 50% HP left
items.description_zh:
持有时, 非幽灵的敌人在死亡时生成小的红色幽灵
使用时, 引爆所有红色幽灵
使用时, 也会击杀所有血量低于50%的幽灵类敌人(包括头目)
items.wiki_description: While held, enemies leave behind ghosts on death. Stronger enemies leave bigger ghosts. Using the item causes the ghosts to explode and damage nearby enemies, and instantly kills all ghost enemies with less than 50% HP.

items.name: False PHD
items.description_en:
+1 Black Heart
 Identifies all pills
Converts all good pills into bad pills
 Eating a stat down pill grants +0.6 damage
 Eating other bad pills spawns a Black Heart
items.description_zh:
+1黑心
 识别所有胶囊
 好胶囊变为坏的
 吃降低属性的胶囊, 伤害+0.6
 吃其它坏胶囊, 生成1黑心
items.wiki_description: Converts good pills into bad pills and identifies all pills. Bad pills now have secondary positive effects. Grants one Black Heart.

items.name: Spin to Win
items.description_en:
Passively grants an orbital that blocks enemy shots and deals 10.5 contact damage per second
Using the item grants:
 +0.5 Speed
Increases speed and damage of orbitals
items.description_zh:
获得1个陀螺环绕物, 阻挡敌人弹幕, 每秒造成10.5点接触伤害
使用时获得:
 移速+0.5
提升环绕物的速度和伤害
items.wiki_description: Gives +0.5 speed and greatly increases the rotation speed and damage of orbitals for 3 seconds. Passively gives Isaac a spinning top orbital that blocks enemy shots and deals contact damage.

items.name: Vasculitis
items.description_en: Enemies explode into tears upon death, which inherit the effects upon death
items.description_zh: 敌人死亡时爆出泪弹, 继承死亡时带有的效果
items.wiki_description: Enemies explode into tears upon death, which inherit the effects of Isaac's tears.

items.name: Giant Cell
items.description_en:
Taking damage spawns a Minisaac
Minisaacs chase and shoot at nearby enemies
items.description_zh:
受伤时生成小以撒
小以撒追击附近敌人并向其发射
items.wiki_description: Causes Isaac to spawn Minisaac familiars when he takes damage, which chase and shoot at nearby enemies.

items.name: Tropicamide
items.description_en:
+2.5 Range
 +0.22 Tear size
items.description_zh:
射程+2.5
 泪弹尺寸+0.22
items.wiki_description: +2.5 Range, Increases tear size.

items.name: Card Reading
items.description_en:
Spawns two portals in the first room of each floor
Leaving the room despawns the portals
 Red: Boss Room
 Yellow: Item Room
 Blue: Secret Room
 Green: Shop
items.description_zh:
在每层的初始房间中生成2个传送门
离开房间时传送门消失
 红色:头目房
 黄色:宝箱房
 蓝色:隐藏房
 绿色: 商店
items.wiki_description: Spawns two portals at the beginning of each floor that each lead to either the Boss Room, Treasure Room, or Secret Room.

items.name: Quints
items.description_en:
Killing an enemy spawns a stationary familiar in its place
Caps at 5 familiars
items.description_zh:
敌人死亡处生成1个不动跟班
最多5个跟班
items.wiki_description: The first five enemies killed in a room will spawn stationary shooting familiars where they died.

items.name: Tooth and Nail
items.description_en:
1 second of invincibility every 6 seconds
Isaac flashes right before the effect triggers
items.description_zh:
每6秒获得1秒无敌
效果触发前角色会闪光
items.wiki_description: Isaac periodically turns into a spiked statue, briefly becoming invulnerable and dealing contact damage.

items.name: Binge Eater
items.description_en:
+1 Health
 Full health
Item pedestals cycle between their item and a food item
Picking up a food item grants:
 Heal 2 hearts
 Temporary +3.6 damage
2 permanent stat ups (depending on the food)
 -0.03 speed
items.description_zh:
+1心之容器
 回满血
所有底座道具会周期性地切换为食物道具
拾起食物道具时获得:
 额外治疗1红心
 暂时伤害+3.6
永久提升2项属性(取决于食物)
 移速-0.03
items.wiki_description: +1 Red Heart Container and fully heals Isaac. Item pedestals also offer a random food item. Picking up a food item temporarily grants +3.6 damage and permanently boosts 2 stats.

items.name: Guppy's Eye
items.description_en: Reveals the contents of chests, sacks, shopkeepers, and fireplaces before they're opened or destroyed
items.description_zh: 在打开或摧毁前, 揭示箱子, 福袋, 店主, 火堆的内容
items.wiki_description: Shows the contents of Chests, Fire Places, Grab Bags, and Shopkeepers before they're opened/destroyed.

items.name: Strawman
items.description_en:
+1 Bomb
 Spawns Keeper as a second character
When he dies, spawns blue spiders and permanently removes Strawman and any item that he has picked up from the inventory
 Devil Room items cost coins while Strawman is alive
 Strawman can pick up story items
items.description_zh:
+1炸弹
 生成店主作为第二个角色
店主死亡时生成蓝蜘蛛并永久移除稻草人及其拾起的道具
 店主活着时恶魔交易花费硬币
 店主也能拾起剧情道具
items.wiki_description: Spawns a controllable Keeper to fight enemies alongside Isaac, functioning similarly to Jacob and Esau. If Keeper dies, he spawns 5 blue spiders and Strawman is removed from Isaac's inventory.

items.name: Dad's Note
items.description_en:
Begins the Ascent
Trinkets left in previous Treasure or Boss Rooms turn into Cracked Keys
items.description_zh:
开始回溯
之前留在宝箱房或头目房的饰品会变成红钥匙碎片
items.wiki_description: Sends Isaac on an Ascent toward Home.

items.name: Sausage
items.description_en:
+1 Health
 +0.2 Speed
 +0.5 Tears
 +0.5 Damage
 +2.5 Range
 +0.16 Shot speed
 +1 Luck
 Full health
 +6.9% Devil/Angel Room chance
 +6.9% Planetarium chance
items.description_zh:
+1心之容器
 移速+0.2
 射速+0.5
 伤害+0.5
 射程+2.5
 弹速+0.16
 幸运+1
 回满血
 恶魔房/天使房概率+6.9%
 星象房概率+6.9%
items.wiki_description: Adds a Red Heart Container, fully heals Isaac, and gives +0.2 Speed, +0.5 Damage, +0.5 Tears, +2.5 Range, +0.2 Shot Speed, and +1.0 Luck. Increases the chance of encountering a Devil Room, Angel Room, and/or Planetarium each by 6.9%.

items.name: Options?
items.description_en: Allows Isaac to choose from two different room clear rewards
items.description_zh: 允许角色从两个不同的房间清理奖励中选择
